## Setup

First, we load the `tidyverse` package to give us tools for data manipulation and visualization.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

## Question

Does experience level (class year: freshman, sophomore, junior, senior) in NCAA Division 1 volleyball affect player stats substantially?

## Loading the Data

We read in the 2020–2026 NCAA Division 1 volleyball dataset.

```{r}
#| label: load-data

volleyball <- read_csv("data/ncaa_d1_volleyball_2020_2026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

glimpse(volleyball)
```
